dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projection forgets commutativity from an additive commutative monoid-with-one structure, retaining the additive monoid and distinguished element 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass plumbing used to interpret the numeral 1 in ENNReal; it does not add a separate mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projection extracts the distinguished element 1 from an additive monoid-with-one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the ENNReal value 1 in the lower-bound assumption 1 <= p.

dependency_coverage.name: AddSubgroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: An AddSubgroup of an additive group is a subset containing zero and closed under addition and negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The Lp collection is represented as an additive subgroup of almost-everywhere equivalence classes of real-valued functions.

dependency_coverage.name: AddSubgroup.instSetLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: This makes an additive subgroup behave as a set through its carrier and identifies subgroups whose carriers agree.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It lets membership in MeasureTheory.Lp be read as the carrier predicate defining the subtype in both conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: And P Q is the conjunction asserting both propositions P and Q.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target requires both existence of a normed additive commutative group structure and existence of a completeness structure.

dependency_coverage.name: CompleteSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: CompleteSpace alpha asserts that every Cauchy filter in the given uniform space on alpha converges.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its nonempty instance is the second claimed structure, expressing completeness of the Lp subtype for the canonical uniform structure induced by its normed group structure.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: ENNReal is the type of nonnegative real numbers extended by a top element infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The exponent p ranges over extended nonnegative reals, so p may in particular be infinity.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal.instPartialOrder
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard partial order on extended nonnegative reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the ordinary ENNReal interpretation of the condition 1 <= p and of the finite-norm carrier condition inside Lp.

dependency_coverage.name: Fact
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fact P is a typeclass wrapper carrying a proof of proposition P.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes 1 <= p an implicit required hypothesis available to the Lp normed-group instance.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the exponent restriction 1 <= p using the standard order on ENNReal.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A measurable-space structure designates the measurable subsets of a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The proposition is universally quantified over an arbitrary underlying type equipped with an arbitrary measurable-space structure.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.AEEqFun
dependency_coverage.meaning: AEEqFun alpha beta mu is the quotient of beta-valued functions on alpha by equality almost everywhere with respect to mu.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Elements of the asserted Lp subtype are almost-everywhere equivalence classes of real-valued functions, not pointwise functions.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.AEEqFun.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This transports pointwise additive-group operations to almost-everywhere equivalence classes of functions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the ambient additive group in which the Lp carrier is an additive subgroup.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: IsProbabilityMeasure mu asserts that mu is a probability measure, in particular that the total mass is one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem is restricted to probability measures rather than arbitrary measures.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Lp
dependency_coverage.meaning: MeasureTheory.Lp E p mu is the additive subgroup of almost-everywhere equivalence classes f whose extended Lp seminorm eLpNorm(f, p, mu) is strictly below infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the underlying subtype: real-valued almost-everywhere function classes having finite extended Lp norm.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Lp.instNormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: For p >= 1, this supplies the canonical normed additive commutative group structure on the subtype of finite-Lp-norm almost-everywhere function classes.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It witnesses the first conjunct and also supplies the concrete metric and uniform structure with respect to which the second conjunct asserts completeness.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
dependency_coverage.meaning: A measure on a measurable space assigns extended nonnegative sizes to measurable sets with the usual countable-additivity properties.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified mu determines almost-everywhere equality and the Lp norm; it is further assumed to be a probability measure.

dependency_coverage.name: Membership.mem
dependency_coverage.meaning: This applies the membership relation associated with a set-like object.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses that an almost-everywhere function class belongs to the Lp additive subgroup, thereby defining the subtype.

dependency_coverage.name: Nonempty
dependency_coverage.meaning: Nonempty T asserts that the type T has at least one inhabitant.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to structure types, it asserts existence of the two requested structures; the conclusion is not merely a direct assertion that the underlying Lp subtype has an element.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: A normed additive commutative group is an abelian additive group with a separating norm whose induced distance is compatible with addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the algebraic and metric structure whose existence on the real-valued Lp subtype forms the first conjunct.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets commutativity from a normed additive commutative group while retaining its normed additive group structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is structural plumbing used to recover the ambient additive group on Real; it changes none of the target's quantifiers or claims.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets norm separation while retaining the seminormed additive commutative group structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes the pseudo-metric and topological additive-group structures needed to build the almost-everywhere function space and the Lp uniform structure.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets the norm and metric from a normed additive group, retaining its additive group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the ordinary additive group on Real used for pointwise operations on almost-everywhere function classes.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets a natural-number literal in a type equipped with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the literal 1 as an element of ENNReal in the assumption 1 <= p.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: This derives the interpretation of the numeral 1 from a type's distinguished One element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of the typeclass route that produces the ENNReal lower bound 1.

dependency_coverage.name: PartialOrder.toPreorder
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets antisymmetry from a partial order, retaining its preorder relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass plumbing exposing the standard ENNReal order for 1 <= p.

dependency_coverage.name: Preorder.toLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the less-than-or-equal relation from a preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the relation used in the lower-bound hypothesis 1 <= p.

dependency_coverage.name: PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts the uniform-space structure induced by a pseudo-metric space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the uniform structure on the Lp subtype that the CompleteSpace conjunct refers to.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The Lp functions in this proposition are specifically real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard normed additive commutative group structure on the real numbers, using absolute value as the norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the pointwise additive and normed ambient structure for the real-valued almost-everywhere functions used in Lp.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddCommGroup.toIsTopologicalAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Every seminormed additive commutative group has continuous addition and negation, hence is a topological additive group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real it justifies transporting additive-group operations to almost-everywhere equivalence classes.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the pseudo-metric space induced by a seminormed additive commutative group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the pseudo-metric and ensuing topology on Real and on the Lp subtype that appear in the elaborated structures.

dependency_coverage.name: SetLike.instMembership
dependency_coverage.meaning: This turns the carrier map of a SetLike object into an element-membership relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the notation and predicate for membership in the Lp additive subgroup used by the subtype constructor.

dependency_coverage.name: Subtype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtype of a predicate consists of values together with proofs that they satisfy that predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The space receiving both structures is the type of almost-everywhere real-valued function classes that belong to Lp.

dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts the topology induced by a uniform-space structure.

binders: An arbitrary type Omega equipped with a measurable-space structure.
A measure mu on Omega, equipped with a proof that mu is a probability measure.
An exponent p in the extended nonnegative reals ENNReal, equipped with a proof that 1 <= p.
hypotheses: mu is a probability measure on the chosen measurable space.
The extended-nonnegative-real exponent p satisfies 1 <= p.
conclusions: There exists a normed additive commutative group structure on the subtype of real-valued almost-everywhere equivalence classes belonging to MeasureTheory.Lp Real p mu.
There exists a CompleteSpace structure on that same subtype, with completeness measured using the canonical uniform structure induced by the Lp normed additive commutative group instance.
mathematical_definitions: MeasureTheory.AEEqFun Omega Real mu consists of real-valued functions on Omega modulo equality mu-almost everywhere.
MeasureTheory.Lp Real p mu is the additive subgroup of such almost-everywhere classes whose extended Lp norm is strictly less than infinity.
The subtype in the conclusion consists of an almost-everywhere function class together with evidence that it belongs to this finite-Lp-norm subgroup.
A CompleteSpace structure asserts convergence of every Cauchy filter for the specified uniform structure.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurable space Omega, every probability measure mu on it, and every extended-nonnegative-real exponent p with 1 <= p, the type of mu-almost-everywhere equivalence classes of real-valued functions having finite extended Lp norm admits a normed additive commutative group structure and is complete for the canonical uniform structure induced by that Lp normed group structure.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The measure is required to be a probability measure; the proposition does not quantify over arbitrary measures.
The exponent is restricted by 1 <= p but otherwise ranges over ENNReal, so the infinity exponent is included and there is no explicit finiteness assumption p < infinity.
The scalar field is fixed to Real; no complex-valued or general normed-space-valued version is asserted.

The conclusion gives a normed additive commutative group and completeness, but it does not explicitly assert a real scalar-module or normed-vector-space structure; describing it literally as a Banach space would import structure absent from the proposition.

Each conjunct is a Nonempty claim about a structure type. The fully explicit second conjunct uses the canonical Lp normed-group instance to determine its uniform structure rather than depending on an existential witness selected by the first conjunct.

The hypotheses are satisfiable, for example on a one-point probability space with p = 1, and the Lp subtype contains the zero class, so no evident vacuity arises from impossible premises or an empty carrier.
